name: Box Hill Big Blind Bonanza 2019
information:
**Please note**: There is no 3x3x3 being held
This competition will run between 9:00-16:30.
The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Multiblind**.

**Competitors must pick between either 3x3x3 Multiblind or 3x3x3 Fewest Moves**

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
